Implement `solution.py` with a mutable `RecipeShelf` class.

Public API:
- `RecipeShelf(recipes=())`, where every recipe is a mapping with exactly `slug`, `title`, and `tags`.
- `add(recipe)` adds one recipe.
- `edit(slug, *, title=None, tags=None)` updates supplied fields and returns the updated recipe.
- `detail(slug)` returns one recipe.
- `list_all()` returns all recipes ordered by slug.
- `resolve(path)` returns `("page", payload)` for `/`, `/recipes`, and `/recipes/<slug>`, and returns `("redirect", "/recipes")` for `/start`. Unknown paths raise `KeyError`.

Validation:
- Slugs must be non-empty lowercase strings containing only ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens.
- Titles must be non-empty strings after trimming.
- Tags must be an iterable of non-empty strings; trim each tag and preserve its order.
- Duplicate slugs raise `ValueError`; unknown slugs raise `KeyError`.
- Empty shelves are valid.
- `/recipes` resolves to the same value shape as `list_all`; `/` has payload `{"message": "Recipe shelf"}`.
- All stored recipes and all returned payloads must be deeply independent from caller-owned and previously returned objects. No public operation may mutate its arguments.

import unittest
from collections import UserDict

from solution import RecipeShelf


class RecipeShelfTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_routes_and_add_edit_list(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf()
        self.assertEqual(shelf.list_all(), [])
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/"), ("page", {"message": "Recipe shelf"}))
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/recipes"), ("page", []))
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/start"), ("redirect", "/recipes"))
        shelf.add({"slug": "z-soup", "title": "  Soup  ", "tags": [" hot ", "easy"]})
        shelf.add({"slug": "apple2", "title": "Apple", "tags": ()})
        self.assertEqual(shelf.list_all(), [
            {"slug": "apple2", "title": "Apple", "tags": []},
            {"slug": "z-soup", "title": "Soup", "tags": ["hot", "easy"]},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(shelf.edit("z-soup", title=" New soup "),
                         {"slug": "z-soup", "title": "New soup", "tags": ["hot", "easy"]})
        self.assertEqual(shelf.edit("z-soup", tags=(x for x in [" one ", "two"])),
                         {"slug": "z-soup", "title": "New soup", "tags": ["one", "two"]})

    def test_constructor_accepts_mappings_and_copies_nested_input(self):
        tags = ["first"]
        recipe = UserDict({"slug": "dish-1", "title": " Dish ", "tags": tags})
        shelf = RecipeShelf([recipe])
        tags.append("later")
        recipe["title"] = "Changed"
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("dish-1"),
                         {"slug": "dish-1", "title": "Dish", "tags": ["first"]})

    def test_every_returned_payload_is_deeply_independent(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf([{"slug": "dish", "title": "Dish", "tags": ["a"]}])
        detail = shelf.detail("dish")
        listing = shelf.list_all()
        resolved = shelf.resolve("/recipes/dish")
        detail["tags"].append("bad")
        listing[0]["title"] = "Bad"
        resolved[1]["tags"][0] = "bad"
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("dish"),
                         {"slug": "dish", "title": "Dish", "tags": ["a"]})
        self.assertIsNot(shelf.detail("dish")["tags"], shelf.detail("dish")["tags"])

    def test_duplicates_unknowns_and_paths(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf([{"slug": "a", "title": "A", "tags": []}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            shelf.add({"slug": "a", "title": "Again", "tags": []})
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            shelf.detail("missing")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            shelf.edit("missing", title="X")
        for path in ("", "/unknown", "/recipes/a/extra", "/recipes/"):
            with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
                shelf.resolve(path)

    def test_validation_and_failed_edit_does_not_change_state(self):
        valid = {"slug": "good-2", "title": "Good", "tags": ["x"]}
        for slug in ("", "Upper", "under_score", "é", "- bad"):
            bad = dict(valid, slug=slug)
            with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                RecipeShelf([bad])
        for title in ("", "   ", 3):
            with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                RecipeShelf([dict(valid, title=title)])
        for tags in ([""], ["  "], [1], 3):
            with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                RecipeShelf([dict(valid, tags=tags)])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RecipeShelf([dict(valid, extra=True)])
        shelf = RecipeShelf([valid])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            shelf.edit("good-2", tags=["ok", " "])
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("good-2"), valid)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
